flood.name: Flood
flood.do1: Move to higher ground immediately when water levels start rising.
flood.do2: Keep drinking water, dry food, torch, medicines and documents in a waterproof bag.
flood.do3: Switch off electricity and gas connections before leaving the house.
flood.do4: Drink only boiled or chlorinated water to prevent waterborne disease.
flood.do5: Follow official evacuation instructions and move to the designated relief centre.
flood.dont1: Do not walk, swim or drive through flowing flood water.
flood.dont2: Do not touch electrical poles, wires or switches in waterlogged areas.
flood.dont3: Do not eat food that has been in contact with flood water.
flood.dont4: Do not spread or believe rumours; rely on official bulletins.
flood.dont5: Do not return home until authorities declare the area safe.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.do1: Drop, cover and hold on under a sturdy table until the shaking stops.
earthquake.do2: Stay away from windows, mirrors and heavy furniture that can topple.
earthquake.do3: If outdoors, move to an open area away from buildings, trees and power lines.
earthquake.do4: Secure heavy furniture and water heaters to walls in advance.
earthquake.do5: After the shaking stops, check for injuries, gas leaks and structural damage.
earthquake.dont1: Do not run out of the building while the ground is still shaking.
earthquake.dont2: Do not use lifts during or immediately after an earthquake.
earthquake.dont3: Do not light matches or switch on electricals if you suspect a gas leak.
earthquake.dont4: Do not enter damaged buildings before an official safety inspection.
earthquake.dont5: Do not block roads or emergency lines with non-urgent calls or travel.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.do1: Watch for warning signs such as new cracks, tilting trees or sudden muddy water.
landslide.do2: Evacuate immediately if you hear rumbling sounds or see moving debris.
landslide.do3: Move away from the path of the slide, sideways rather than downhill.
landslide.do4: Plant vegetation on slopes and maintain proper drainage around the house.
landslide.do5: Report cracks, seepage or slope movement to the district authority.
landslide.dont1: Do not build houses close to steep slopes or the edge of cut hills.
landslide.dont2: Do not block or divert natural drainage channels on a hillside.
landslide.dont3: Do not remain in a vulnerable structure during continuous heavy rainfall.
landslide.dont4: Do not travel on hill roads during or immediately after heavy rain.
landslide.dont5: Do not undertake unauthorised excavation or blasting on slopes.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.do1: Drink water frequently even if you are not thirsty; use ORS or lemon water.
heatwave.do2: Wear light-coloured, loose cotton clothing and cover your head outdoors.
heatwave.do3: Stay indoors during the peak hours between 11:00 and 16:00.
heatwave.do4: Check on elderly people, young children and outdoor workers regularly.
heatwave.do5: Move a person with heat stroke to a cool place, sponge with water and seek medical help.
heatwave.dont1: Do not go out barefoot or in the direct sun during peak afternoon hours.
heatwave.dont2: Do not leave children or pets in a parked vehicle.
heatwave.dont3: Do not consume alcohol, tea, coffee or high-sugar carbonated drinks.
heatwave.dont4: Do not cook in closed, poorly ventilated rooms during peak heat.
heatwave.dont5: Do not undertake strenuous outdoor work in the afternoon.

cyclone.name: Cyclone
cyclone.do1: Keep an emergency kit, mobile phone charged and important documents ready.
cyclone.do2: Listen to official radio and television bulletins for updates.
cyclone.do3: Secure loose objects, hoardings and rooftop items around the house.
cyclone.do4: Store drinking water and shift to a designated cyclone shelter when advised.
cyclone.do5: Keep livestock untied so that they can move to safety.
cyclone.dont1: Do not venture out into the sea; fishermen must stay ashore.
cyclone.dont2: Do not go outside during the lull as the eye of the storm passes.
cyclone.dont3: Do not shelter under trees, near loose structures or damaged buildings.
cyclone.dont4: Do not touch fallen or hanging electric wires.
cyclone.dont5: Do not believe rumours; depend on IMD and district administration updates.
